import MilneLib.SymmetricPower.RelativePowerGeometricallyReduced
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Geometrically.Integral

/-!
# Geometric integrality of finite relative powers

Finite relative powers of geometrically integral schemes locally of finite type
over a field are geometrically integral. Together with the invariant function
field theorem, this supplies separability for symmetric powers of geometrically
integral varieties in Milne III.3.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib

/-- Finite relative powers preserve geometric irreducibility over a field,
including the zeroth power. -/
theorem relativePower_geometricallyIrreducible {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (V : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (n : ℕ)
    [GeometricallyIrreducible V.hom] :
    GeometricallyIrreducible (relativePower V n).hom := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    let S := Spec (CommRingCat.of k)
    have h : IsTerminal (relativePower V 0) :=
      isLimitEquivIsTerminalOfIsEmpty (Over S) _
        (limit.isLimit (Discrete.functor (fun _ : Fin 0 => V)))
    let e : relativePower V 0 ≅ Over.mk (𝟙 S) := h.uniqueUpToIso Over.mkIdTerminal
    apply (MorphismProperty.over_iso_iff (@GeometricallyIrreducible) e).mpr
    rw [geometricallyIrreducible_iff, geometrically_iff_of_isClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    intro K _ y
    change IrreducibleSpace ↥(pullback (𝟙 S) y)
    haveI : IsIso (pullback.snd (𝟙 S) y) := inferInstance
    exact (pullback.snd (𝟙 S) y).homeomorph.irreducibleSpace_iff.mpr inferInstance
  | succ n ih =>
    letI := ih
    let W := relativePower V n
    have h := extendFanIsLimit (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => V)
      (limit.isLimit (Discrete.functor (fun _ : Fin n => V)))
      (prodIsProd V W)
    let e : V ⨯ W ≅ relativePower V (n + 1) :=
      h.conePointUniqueUpToIso (limit.isLimit _)
    apply (MorphismProperty.over_iso_iff (@GeometricallyIrreducible) e).mp
    haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible (pullback.snd V.hom W.hom ≫ W.hom) :=
      GeometricallyIrreducible.comp _ _
    have he : (V ⨯ W).hom = (Over.prodLeftIsoPullback V W).hom ≫
        (pullback.snd V.hom W.hom ≫ W.hom) := by
      simp
    rw [he]
    exact (MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso (@GeometricallyIrreducible) _ _).mpr
      inferInstance

/-- A finite relative power of a geometrically integral scheme locally of
finite type over a field is geometrically integral. -/
theorem relativePower_geometricallyIntegral {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (V : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (n : ℕ)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral V.hom] :
    GeometricallyIntegral (relativePower V n).hom := by
  letI := relativePower_geometricallyReduced V n
  letI := relativePower_geometricallyIrreducible V n
  exact GeometricallyIntegral.of_geometricallyReduced_of_geometricallyIrreducible _

/-- Geometric integrality of the source gives an integral finite relative power. -/
theorem relativePower_isIntegral {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (V : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (n : ℕ)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral V.hom] :
    IsIntegral (relativePower V n).left := by
  letI := relativePower_geometricallyIntegral V n
  exact GeometricallyIntegral.isIntegral_of_subsingleton (relativePower V n).hom

end MilneLib
